notes.title: PING REDUX v1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We've appreciated all the feedback that you've sent in. We've patched up some problem areas with bosses with the info and fixed some levels. :)

- Changed delete save data text to be less ambiguous
- Changed how the bullets interact with the player so that you aren't shoved out
- Added a new visual option to toggle in options

We are always happy to hear from our players so feel free to reach out to us in any way possible! We'll do our best to respond.

We are looking at doing more levels, but of course we want to base whatever level update we do on a unified theme, so we are looking for any suggestions from you! Let us know in the comments!
